item.title: Britain’s Starmer ends China trip aimed at reset despite Trump warning
item.description: British Prime Minister Keir Starmer wrapped up a four-day trip to China on Saturday, after his bid to forge closer ties prompted warnings from US President Donald Trump, Azernews reports, citing Arab News.

item.title: President Ilham Aliyev makes phone call to President of Iran
item.description: On January 31, President of the Republic of Azerbaijan Ilham Aliyev made a phone call to President of the Islamic Republic of Iran Masoud Pezeshkian.

item.title: US Embassy in Türkiye scales back social media updates amid US government shutdown
item.description: The US Embassy in Türkiye stated on Saturday that its social media channels will not be updated regularly until full operations resume, except for urgent safety and security announcements. The move comes as the US government entered a temporary shutdown after Congress failed to pass a funding law, Azernews ​reports, citing Yeni Safak.

item.title: Pakistan says India-backed militants behind deadly Balochistan attacks
item.description: Pakistan’s security forces have killed more than 70 militants in operations carried out over the past two days in the Balochistan province, Azernews reports, citing Pakistani media outlets.

item.title: Production resumes at Kazakhstan’s Tengiz oil field
item.description: Oil production has resumed at the Tengiz oil field in Kazakhstan, Azernews reports, citing the country’s Ministry of Energy.

item.title: France tightens infant milk rules after recalls
item.description: France has lowered the safety limit for cereulide toxin in infant formula, aiming to strengthen protections after several major ​groups ordered worldwide recalls over contamination concerns, the farm ministry said on Saturday, Azernews reports, citing Arab News.

item.title: How Brussels sabotaging Armenia–Azerbaijan peace process
item.description: The European Union’s decision to allocate €20 million to Armenia through the European Peace Facility raises serious and unavoidable questions, not only about Brussels’ judgment, but about its credibility as a neutral actor in the Armenia–Azerbaijan peace process.

item.title: US greenlights multiple defense deals with Israel
item.description: Separately, the department approved a possible sale of Joint Light Tactical Vehicles and related equipment valued at about $1.98 billion. AM General LLC would be the principal contractor, it said.

item.title: Trump confirms start of talks on Greenland, hopes for “good deal” for both Washington, Europe
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump has confirmed that negotiations regarding Greenland have begun, expressing hope that the outcome will be a “good deal” for both Washington and Europe.

item.title: AJet flight from Istanbul to Tehran makes emergency landing in Ankara
item.description: A passenger aircraft operated by AJet, en route from Istanbul to Tehran, was forced to make an emergency landing in Ankara, Azernews reports, citing foreign media.
